_role: Main-battle workhorse chassis (T-34/Sherman/Leopard register). HULL_MASSING_SPEC.md's flagship: distinct boxy lower tub, a genuinely separate sloped glacis plate, flat sponson/fender shelves over the track run, a rear engine deck, and a flat turret-ring platform on top. Authored at roughly the sidecar size (3.0 x 1.8 x 5.5, nose at -Z) so ModuleCatalog.get_hull_mesh_fit()'s orientation search resolves to identity and its per-axis fit stays near 1:1.

primitives._note: Volume A - lower hull tub. Full width, near-vertical sides, flat belly at -Y (the belly stays flat for the inverted-pintle/rotor mount). Top at y=+0.09, i.e. tub_frac ~0.55 of total height.

Volume B - upper structure / fighting compartment. Narrower (upper_w ~0.78) and set BACK from the nose so the glacis below reads as its own frontal facet rather than a continuous loft. Rear portion is the engine deck.
Glacis plate. SLOPE's bevel is on its top-front (-Z) edge, which is exactly a glacis; occupies the nose region ahead of Volume B.
Volume C - left fender/sponson shelf at the tub/upper junction, flat-topped, running the length of the track. This is the side-mount real estate.
Volume C - right fender/sponson shelf (mirror of the left).
Turret ring collar on the roof - anchors a top-pintle weapon visually and gives the hull-to-turret relationship the spec asks for.
